title: QGIS EDI Building Block Portfolio
description: Catalog of workspace-developed QGIS plugins and supporting geospatial services that can participate in the QGIS EDI contract-driven workflow.

contractModel.principle: Metadata remains context-dependent; each block declares the logical data and process contract relevant to its execution context.

buildingBlocks.title: COP Defence
buildingBlocks.contract: geospatial/STAC data -> COP outputs and services

buildingBlocks.title: STAC COP Reporter
buildingBlocks.contract: STAC items and COP context -> reports

buildingBlocks.title: UMM-STAC Converter
buildingBlocks.contract: UMM/STAC documents <-> normalized metadata

buildingBlocks.title: COP STAC Exporter
buildingBlocks.contract: QGIS vector/raster layers -> STAC catalog, items, and assets

buildingBlocks.title: Situational Awareness
buildingBlocks.contract: geospatial/event inputs -> awareness layers and services

buildingBlocks.title: Share Common Operating Picture
buildingBlocks.contract: COP layers -> shared service or exported artifacts

buildingBlocks.title: OSM-MGCP Converter
buildingBlocks.contract: OSM/MGCP files -> converted vector data

buildingBlocks.title: IPFS Imagery Uploader
buildingBlocks.contract: raster/image assets -> IPFS CID and URI

buildingBlocks.title: Satellite STAC Importer
buildingBlocks.contract: STAC/API assets -> local or managed QGIS imagery layers

buildingBlocks.title: HEIF TTL Importer
buildingBlocks.capability: Import HEIF imagery and TTL metadata
buildingBlocks.contract: HEIF/TTL files -> georeferenced imagery and metadata

buildingBlocks.title: Medical HSI Manager
buildingBlocks.contract: HSI datasets -> managed and visualized analysis layers

buildingBlocks.title: Archaeological HSI Manager
buildingBlocks.contract: HSI datasets -> managed archaeological analysis layers

buildingBlocks.title: Asbestos HSI Manager
buildingBlocks.contract: HSI datasets -> classified and managed results

buildingBlocks.title: GRC Tools
buildingBlocks.contract: GIS inputs -> analysis layers and reports

buildingBlocks.title: DJI Drone Processor
buildingBlocks.capability: Process DJI imagery and flight metadata
buildingBlocks.contract: DJI imagery and telemetry -> corrected imagery, DSM, point cloud, and mesh

buildingBlocks.title: HSI Pushbroom Mosaicker
buildingBlocks.contract: pushbroom strips -> georeferenced hyperspectral mosaic

buildingBlocks.title: General Raster Importer
buildingBlocks.capability: Import and georeference general raster formats
buildingBlocks.contract: raster and optional GCP/TTL metadata -> QGIS raster layer

buildingBlocks.title: Fabric Uploader
buildingBlocks.contract: local assets -> Fabric-managed objects and URLs

buildingBlocks.title: NGIM-NGI Converter
buildingBlocks.contract: NGIM/NGI inputs -> normalized geospatial products

buildingBlocks.title: Vector Data Quality Check
buildingBlocks.contract: vector layers -> validation findings and report

buildingBlocks.title: Trash HSI Manager
buildingBlocks.capability: Manage waste and trash hyperspectral imagery
buildingBlocks.contract: HSI data -> managed and classified outputs

buildingBlocks.title: STAC Imagery API
buildingBlocks.capability: Serve and package satellite imagery using STAC
buildingBlocks.contract: HTTP imagery requests -> STAC items, packages, and optional anchors

buildingBlocks.title: UMM-STAC API
buildingBlocks.contract: HTTP metadata requests -> UMM/STAC responses

buildingBlocks.title: Image Analyzer Process
buildingBlocks.contract: image asset and process request -> analytical results

buildingBlocks.title: MGCP Semantic Router
buildingBlocks.capability: Route and interpret MGCP semantic queries
buildingBlocks.contract: semantic/API request -> routed MGCP operation and result

buildingBlocks.title: Cesium COP Dashboard
buildingBlocks.contract: web/STAC/geospatial services -> operational dashboard
